insights.summary: Q2 FY27 total income was ₹348 Cr (up 90% year on year, 13% on the quarter) with EBITDA of ₹73 Cr and PAT of ₹34 Cr. EBITDA margin slipped about 300 bps to roughly 21% as freight doubled to ₹20 Cr and gas prices rose; management now only commits to 'more than 20%' (from about 24% in August) and expects to pass the costs on from Q3. FY28 revenue guidance of more than ₹1,600 Cr, ₹250 Cr capex and the MNC contract timeline (trials in Q4, commercial from Q1 FY28) were reiterated.

what_changed.text: EBITDA margin: now 'more than 20%' (Aug call: sustain ~24%)
FY28 revenue above ₹1,600 Cr; capex ₹250 Cr; MNC contract commercial in Q1 FY28
Buildings 3 and 4 operational Q4 FY28 or Q1 FY29
Freight and gas cost increases to be passed on from Q3

tone.label: cautious
tone.quote: This is really a challenging time as of today, okay.

analyst_questions.topic: Why did margin fall 300 bps in a quarter?
analyst_questions.answer: About 200 bps from freight and energy costs on orders already accepted and about 100 bps from product mix.
'I don't know. I will say I will do more than 20%.' No assurance of 24-25%.
Volume up 7% on the quarter and 62-73% year on year; prices up 10-15% since March on raw materials; rest is mix.
Existing customers asked for more quantity and a couple of marquee customers were onboarded in the last six months.

red_flags.text: Margin fell about 300 bps in Q2 and management declined to say it will recover; the earlier 24% was not held.
Raw-material availability is a 'challenge' in the current crisis and freight rates are volatile; 70% of sales are exports.
Net working capital is 149 days and total debt ₹615 Cr (of which short-term ₹329 Cr), while capex doubles to ₹250 Cr.
Q2 revenue was misstated as ₹147 Cr in the prepared remarks and corrected to ₹348 Cr in a footnote; ROCE also corrected.
